Window types

Combine any types in one frame
W-01

Casement

Side-hinged, cranks open outward. The tightest seal of any opening window.

Learn more →
W-02

Awning

Top-hinged, opens outward from the bottom. Can stay open in the rain.

Learn more →
W-03

Picture

Fixed glass in the narrowest frame, for the most glass and light.

Learn more →
W-04

Fixed

Fixed glass that looks like a casement from outside, so it sits evenly beside opening units.

Learn more →

The details that matter

Fusion-welded corners, multi-chamber PVC frames, multi-point locks and sealed glass units with warm-edge spacers. Every window is made to order for the opening it goes into.

  • Dual or triple glass sealed units, Low-E, argon fill
  • Integrated screens and internal grilles
  • Brickmould, jamb extensions and nailing fin to suit your wall
